title: Cute Rat
author: Vedic Kashyap
pages: A rat is so messy. It jumps here and there everywhere; in every corner of the house. Its long tail is so beautiful. Its cute ears are always busy. Bits of papers and chopped veggies on the floor is a bad deed of its sharp teeth. Oh! you little grey mouse.
